correctness.rationale: Invariance of antiderivatives of arbitrary functions of v and w gives \(\mathbb E[w\mid v]=F(v)\) and \(\mathbb E[v\mid w]=bw-a\). Conditional-variance decompositions then give \(\operatorname{Var}(w)-\operatorname{Var}(F(v))=\mathbb E[\dot v^2]\) and \(\operatorname{Var}(v)-b^2\operatorname{Var}(w)=\varepsilon^{-2}\mathbb E[\dot w^2]\), with the combined budget by substitution. Zero square speed plus support invariance forces a constant orbit and hence an equilibrium; otherwise each zero-mean nonzero speed has both signs. The exact checker verifies the vector-field residual and equilibrium polynomial, including the displayed standard coefficients.

value.rationale: The deterministic nullclines are the organizing geometry of FitzHugh--Nagumo. Showing that both are exact stationary regressions and that their residual scatter is exactly the kinetic activity of each coordinate gives an interpretable, checkable constraint on every recurrent statistical state and a sharp equilibrium/non-equilibrium discriminator.
residual_risks: It does not determine the invariant distribution or bifurcation diagram.

final_claim: For the autonomous FitzHugh--Nagumo oscillator \(\dot v=v-v^3/3-w+I\), \(\dot w=\varepsilon(v+a-bw)\) with \(\varepsilon,b>0\), every compactly supported invariant probability measure has the two nullclines as exact conditional regressions and satisfies the two stated variance--speed defects and combined speed budget; either defect vanishes exactly for equilibrium-supported measures, while every other compact stationary state has positive mass on both sides of both nullclines.
limitations: Autonomous planar normalization shown in the record, with compact invariant support.
No stochastic forcing, diffusion, delay, time-varying input, full invariant-density formula, or period formula.
